answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the vertex of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the zenith until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the knoll of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
